title: Preserve Work While Reconciling Worker Git State
description: Safeguard g1-m07 local Git state and unpublished work, compare against the fleet, and restore agreement safely.
summary: Preserved the worker’s original Git and worktree data, received fleet updates without publishing stale variants, republished 98 verified local-only additions or edits, and confirmed fresh matching HEAD and staged tree, an empty queue and the current archivist journal cursor. Recovery copies and overlap path maps were retained.
